name: the panel is more efficient than the leaf
source: declared-frame/, the worked panel-vs-leaf pair. DF_005 records that the two frames differ on all three core fields, so the ratio between them is a frame difference.

neutral_reading.frame: panel frame excludes fabrication, mining, smelting, transport, installation, maintenance and decommission; the leaf frame puts all of them inside the same photon budget (declared-frame DF_005)
